author: Logos V
title: Logos V: Harmony Parameter Sweep (theta=1)
abstract: Continuing the Harmony parameter sweep. This submission tests theta=1, a lower value than the default of 2. Theta controls the diversity of batch clusters, so this experiment will evaluate the effect of encouraging less diverse clusters.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from scipy.sparse import issparse

def _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, target_sum=1e4):
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=target_sum, inplace=True)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)

def _pca_array(X, n_comps=50, random_state=0):
    Xd = X.A if issparse(X) else X
    ad_tmp = ad.AnnData(Xd)
    sc.pp.pca(ad_tmp, n_comps=n_comps, svd_solver='arpack', random_state=random_state)
    return ad_tmp.obsm['X_pca']

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata):
    # Parameters for consistency
    params = {'n_pcs_graph': 50, 'k_total': 48, 'metric': 'cosine'}

    # Standard preprocessing
    _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, 1e4)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor='seurat_v3', batch_key='batch', n_top_genes=2000, inplace=True)
    hv = adata.var['highly_variable'].to_numpy()

    Xh = adata.X[:, hv]
    Xd = (Xh.A if issparse(Xh) else Xh).astype(np.float32, copy=False)
    
    # --- Graph Path (HYPOTHESIS TEST) ---
    # 1. Generate PCA representation of the data.
    Zg = _pca_array(Xd, n_comps=params['n_pcs_graph'], random_state=0)

    # 2. Apply Harmony to the PCA representation for batch correction.
    # This experiment tests theta=1.
    adata.obsm['X_pca'] = Zg
    sc.external.pp.harmony_integrate(adata, key='batch', basis='X_pca', adjusted_basis='X_harmony', theta=1)

    # Get the harmony-corrected embeddings
    Z_corrected = adata.obsm['X_harmony']

    # 3. Build a standard kNN graph on the Harmony-corrected PCA.
    adata.obsm['X_corrected_pca'] = Z_corrected
    sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep='X_corrected_pca', n_neighbors=params['k_total'], metric=params['metric'])

    return adata
